t: An Arduino UNO with a Linux computer and a microcontroller on one board.
steps: Buy the board from the Arduino Store or Micro Center. The 2 GB model lists at 59 US dollars and the 4 GB model at 79 US dollars after a July 2026 price rise.
Get a USB-C power-delivery supply or a powered USB-C dongle.
Connect the board to your computer with a USB-C cable.
Open Arduino App Lab, which comes preinstalled on the board.
Run the LED matrix example to see the grid light up.
Try a ready-made Brick that mixes Python and a sketch.
Add a USB-C dongle with a screen and keyboard to use it as a desktop.
meta: Open Board. From $59. A few stores.
